assessment: This is an important, well-written and easily comprehended quantitative imaging study that analyzes the motion of endo-lysosomal compartments within axons in vivo using simultaneous multiphoton imaging in the mammalian brain. The simultaneous dual two-photon imaging is well-executed and represents a substantive advance in a field that relies heavily on in vitro neuronal culture preparations. The authors address an issue of cell polarity, providing strong support for their ability to determine directional movement (anterograde versus retrograde), and characterize interesting differences in motion, including activity-dependent and calcium-dependent alterations at or near synapses.
